headline: MICHAEL KIWANUKA 🧠 DROPS 💥 STROKE BOMB 💣 While Teasing Fudge 🍫 Album
text:
AWARD WINNING 🎤 singer Michael Kiwanuka 🧑‍🎤 just dropped 🫳 a HEART WRENCHING 💔 Instagram 📸 confession that he is RECOVERING 🩹 from a quite SEVERE 🩸 stroke 🧠 after a BLEED 🩸 in his brain 🧬 triggered by sky HIGH 🏔️ blood pressure 🩸!! The 39 year old 🧔 from London 🏙️ who snatched 🏆 the Mercury Prize 🏅 in 2020 and scored five Brit nominations 🏆 faces a LONG TOUGH 🛣️ journey ahead with heaps of rehab 🏋️ to rebuild after the brain injury 🧠 that hit a few months ago 📅!! Bro is out here fighting 🥊 like a CHAMP 🏆 while his body is literally rebuilding the studio in his head 🎚️, talk about being built DIFFERENT 🦾 after getting absolutely RAILED 💥 by this health scare 😵!!

Kiwanuka 🍫 Daddy dropped the news while announcing his fifth album Fudge 🍬 which he cooked 🎤 up BEFORE the stroke hit 🛑 so fans can still get that intimate brooding sound 🌫️ influenced by Neil Young 🎸!! He admitted the last few months have been a brutal battle ⚔️ with health problems that would totally hinder 🚫 making music 🎵 for the foreseeable future 🌅 yet here he is edging 🫦 closer to recovery every single day 🌡️!! The brain injury was quite severe 🧠 so there's a mountain of rehab 🏔️ waiting but he swears it feels like he's on his way there now 🛤️, missing some US gigs 🇺🇸 recently because the road just wasn't safe yet 🛣️!! Kiwanuka Daddy is out here thanking the incredible NHS staff 🏥 and every medical pro 🩺 who kept him alive and encouraged during this nightmare 🌩️ while his friends and family held him down 🤝 like absolute legends 🦸!!

This has been one of the toughest challenges he's ever faced 😤 but our boy is fighting hard 🥊 to get to the other side where the music flows free again 🎶!! He posted that he looks forward to seeing all of us soon 👀 even if he isn't sure when he'll be back on the road 🛣️ or what that comeback tour will even look like 🎤!! Kiwanuka Daddy canceled all live shows back in July 2025 📅 on medical advice after continued illness kept hammering him 🩹 and now the whole industry is sending love bombs 💌 from every corner 🌍!! BBC Radio 6 Music queen Lauren Laverne chimed in with one day at a time vibes ⏳ while Miguel told him take your time healing brother 🕰️ because the world needs that voice 🗣️!!

Radiohead guitarist Ed O'Brien shot some pure love ❤️ his way and fans flooded the comments with well wishes 🌊 after Kiwanuka first made his mark fifteen years ago 🕰️ as the BBC Sound of 2012 📻!! His first three albums were all Mercury nominated 🏆 before he finally WON 🥇 with his self titled third record in 2020 🏅 which also scored Brit nods for best male solo artist 👑 and album of the year 📀 plus a Grammy nod for best rock album 🪨!! Everybody still loses their minds over Cold Little Heart ❄️ that theme from Big Little Lies 📺 so the pressure is real but Kiwanuka Daddy is handling this stroke recovery like the quiet warrior he is ⚔️!! Fudge was supposed to drop last year 📆 but got postponed after the bleed 🩸 turned his world upside down 🌪️ yet early reviews called it intimate and brooding in all the best ways 🌑!!

Kiwanuka 🍫 Daddy wrapped his message by wishing everyone well 🌟 and looking forward to seeing us further down the road 🛣️ once he's fully on the other side of this nightmare 🌅!! The man is clearly down bad 😩 from the health battle but still dropping an album announcement like a boss move 🕴️ while promising the rehab journey will be worth it in the end 🏁!! From winning the Mercury Prize 🏆 to battling a severe brain bleed 🧠 this legend just keeps proving he's built different 🦿 and the entire music world is rooting hard for his full comeback 🎸!! So here's to Kiwanuka Daddy healing up nice and steady 🩹 because that voice and those tunes are absolutely needed right now 📢!!
